name: aspen-plus
description:
Control Aspen Plus from Codex via the COM API.

Aliases: @aspen, @aspen-plus, Aspen, Aspen Plus.

Use Aspen Plus when the user asks to build, edit, run, debug, or optimize a chemical process flowsheet; to place blocks or connect streams; to set property methods, components, or reactions; to run a simulation and read results; or to perform pinch / heat-integration analysis.

Requires a local Aspen Plus installation and license (Windows only). The plugin drives that installation over COM; it does not ship Aspen Plus.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, and optimize Aspen Plus flowsheets
interface.longDescription: Drives a local Aspen Plus installation over the COM API. Build and edit flowsheets, set property methods, components and reactions, run simulations and read results, optimize with nine algorithms including NSGA-II/III, PSO, DE and constrained Bayesian optimization, and run pinch analysis for heat integration. Includes a documentation-lookup workflow so paths and parameters are never guessed, plus an error diagnose-fix-record loop.
defaultPrompt: Build a CO2-to-olefins flowsheet in Aspen Plus
My RadFrac column will not converge -- diagnose it
Run a pinch analysis on the current flowsheet
